crossRefs.note: Even the jackals offer their breast. They nurse their young ones. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like…
The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for…
toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them…
Then the woman whose the living child was spoke to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, “Oh, my…
Then the king answered, “Give her the living child, and definitely do not kill him. She is his mother.”
The king said to her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him…
So we boiled my son, and ate him: and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;
The labor of fools wearies every one of them; for he doesn’t know how to go to the city.
Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

translations.web: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,
translations.bsb: She treats her young harshly, as if not her own, with no concern that her labor was in vain.
translations.kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
translations.asv: She dealeth hardly with her young ones, as if they were not hers: Though her labor be in vain, she is without fear;
